REJECT
The patch changes behaviour: the original called `IsSigningKeyValue(value)` on the untrimmed value, but `IsRejectedKeyValue` now passes it `value.Trim()`, so any value with leading or trailing whitespace can be accepted or rejected differently. (I couldn't find the source file locally to check whether `IsSigningKeyValue` trims its input itself, so the diff alone doesn't show this is safe.)
